questions.stem: What colour does phenolphthalein turn in an alkaline solution?
questions.explanation: Phenolphthalein is colourless in acidic and neutral solutions and turns pink (or magenta) in alkaline solutions. This clear colour change makes it very useful as an indicator in titrations.

questions.stem: Why is universal indicator not suitable for use in titrations?

options.text: It shows a gradual colour change, making the endpoint difficult to identify precisely
It only works with strong acids

questions.explanation: Universal indicator changes through a range of colours for different pH values, making it difficult to see a sharp, precise endpoint. Single indicators like methyl orange or phenolphthalein give a much clearer colour change at the endpoint.
